prompt: Create ONE original 8-frame special-attack sprite strip for the side-scrolling Sengoku action game Sekigahara Ranbu. Character: Kagekatsu Uesugi. Reference 1 exact identity; reference 2 current in-game painted style and scale; reference 3 loose legacy motion/electric-slash motif only. One row of exactly 8 full-body right-facing poses for a 2048x256 strip. Same anatomy and body scale; katana and restrained blue-white effects inside each cell with 16px margins; pure RGB magenta background. Motion: ready, crouch and draw back, raise as charge gathers, begin diagonal cut, complete slash with contained crescent trail, low follow-through, recover, settle near ready. No text/banner/extra character or effects crossing cells.
visualReview: 画像の画風と人物は良いが、8セル等分の確認で第4〜6コマの青白い斬撃軌跡が隣セルへ連続し、脚と刀身も境界に接触・流出。生成キャンバスの前景連結成分がx=764〜1715にまたがり、同一縮尺・刀身保持・16px余白を守る分離ができないため見送り。出力PNGなし、納品数に含めない。同一タスクの再生成は行わない。

rejectionEvidence.reason: Connected character/effect regions from neighboring action poses span multiple required cells; normalization would crop body or effect and fail required margins.
